sql:
SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    sum(fs.SalesQuantity) AS TotalSalesQuantity,
    sum(fs.ReturnQuantity) AS TotalReturnQuantity,
    round(sum(fs.ReturnQuantity) / nullIf(sum(fs.SalesQuantity), 0) * 100, 2) AS ReturnRatePct
FROM retail.FactSales fs
JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY ReturnRatePct DESC
